active_probe.false_positive_check: POSITIVE Thanos discriminator: /api/v1/stores returns 200 with a JSON object keyed by StoreAPI type (sidecar/store/receive/rule). Prometheus, VictoriaMetrics, Cortex and Mimir all return 404 on /api/v1/stores — this path exists ONLY in Thanos Query. SECONDARY: /api/v1/query response may carry a 'warnings' array referencing partial_response/dedup (Thanos-only PromQL response extension). buildinfo returns Thanos build fields, NOT VM's empty {} and NOT Prometheus-with-goVersion.

pivot_paths: GET /api/v1/stores -> full backend StoreAPI topology (sidecar/store-gateway/receive IPs + RFC1918 endpoints) -> lateral target map
GET /api/v1/status/flags -> object-store bucket config flags -> cloud bucket name disclosure
GET /api/v1/query?query=up -> aggregated multi-cluster target inventory (broader than a single Prometheus)
POST /api/v1/receive on :10907 with Thanos-Tenant header -> unauthenticated metric injection / tenant pollution (write surface — keep severity SEPARATE from read)
vulnerabilities: Design choice (NOT a CVE): no authentication by default on the HTTP API; mirrors Prometheus operator-responsibility model
Thanos Receive remote-write tenant header is identity-only, not authentication — tenant spoofing by design when exposed
CVE-2024-24558 (stdlib/dependency class surfaced in thanos images) — container dependency, not a Thanos-logic CVE
Recurring image-level CVE churn (busybox/stdlib) reported against thanos:vX images — not application vulns
auth_default_thesis: AUTH-OFF-DEFAULT confirmed. Thanos ships every HTTP component with no auth; --http.config is opt-in and rarely set. Distinct from Cortex/Mimir which gate reads/writes behind X-Scope-OrgID (tenant identity, still not auth). Thanos is the closest sibling to Prometheus/VM on posture: the federation/fan-out role makes a single exposed Query a HIGHER-value read target than a single Prometheus because it aggregates many backends. Falsifier: if exposed Thanos Query unauth rate < Prometheus, operators harden the aggregator specifically.
research_questions: Does /api/v1/stores reliably separate Thanos from the rest of the Prometheus-API family at population scale (expected 200-only-on-Thanos)?
What share of exposed Thanos Receive :10907 accept unauthenticated remote-write?
Do exposed Query instances leak object-store bucket names via /api/v1/status/flags?
Is the federation aggregation effect measurable (more series/targets per exposed Thanos than per exposed Prometheus)?
